package.description: MP3val is a small, high-speed tool for MPEG audio files validation and (optionally) fixing problems.

en-US.description: MP3val is a small, high-speed tool for MPEG audio files validation and (optionally) fixing problems.
en-US.longDescription: It was primarily designed for verification of MPEG 1 Layer III (MP3) files, but supports also other MPEG versions and layers.
en-US.name: MP3val (With Frontend)
